name: Wonders of Time grants its raid spell haste (#3796)
contract: Wonders of Time 560541's tooltip is "Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by $s1%. Additionally, all healing done now has a $h% chance to grant you Endless Sands." Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS and BasePoints 2 -> +3%, handled natively by AuraEffect::HandleModCastingSpeed, and it reaches the caster even ungrouped. Effect 2 is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) on 806728 Endless Sands with the record's ProcChance 10, but Spell.dbc gives 560541 ProcFlags 0x0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the 10% chance never happened. The proc is restricted to direct healing; periodic healing ticks are excluded. This scenario asserts only the deterministic haste half and the absence of Endless Sands before any heal. The 10% proc cannot be asserted here without a false-failure rate far above the harness's tolerance: 806728 lasts 15 sec and a Chronomancer heal is bound by the global cooldown, so at most about ten independent trials can fall inside one aura lifetime, giving at best a 65% chance that the aura is still up when a sequential assertion runs. apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md states that this version provides no automatic statistical test, so the proc rate is left to source review and to a Ghost e2e statistical run.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Reverse Wound's cast time without Wonders of Time
Wonders of Time's raid area aura reaches its own caster
Wonders of Time speeds up spell casts by about 3%
No Endless Sands before any healing is done
